in_marathi.name: Sharvayaksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Shiva's watchful, protective gaze
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvayaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvayaksha represents the watchful and protective gaze of Lord Shiva. It is believed that Shiva, as a protector, keeps a constant watch over his devotees, providing them with strength and courage.
